name: marine-pollution-image-analyzer
description: Repo-level tooling (Git hooks) for the Marine Pollution Image Analyzer monorepo.

*.py: bash -c 'if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff check --fix "$@" && ruff format "$@"; else echo "ruff not installed; skipping Python lint/format (see README Getting Started)"; fi' --
